text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with topic sentences and a concluding wrap-up","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is structured into identifiable sections that develop the argument in a more ordered way."},{"evidence":"repeated linking phrases like \"On the other hand,\" \"Otherwise,\" and \"Overall\"","quality":"transitional control","description":"The essay uses discourse markers to connect ideas and signal progression more consistently."},{"evidence":"multi-sentence explanations for benefits, obstacles, opportunities, and experiences","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay expands its points with more developed reasoning rather than brief unsupported claims."},{"evidence":"examples such as \"famous actors\" and the homeless-sharing anecdote","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay includes more concrete examples to illustrate its claims."},{"evidence":"few sentences that maintain the same general topic across paragraphs","quality":"focus and coherence","description":"The essay stays more consistently on its main idea and keeps its points more connected."},{"evidence":"some varied sentence openings such as \"Nobody is perfect\" and \"On the other hand\"","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay shows somewhat more variation in how sentences begin and are built."}]}
